title: Concept: Gradle properties point at a cleartext repository
description: gradle.properties declares a repository URL property that uses cleartext http, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The whole build resolves through an unencrypted endpoint, so artifacts and checksums can be replaced in transit.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through gradle.properties (gradle).
risk: The whole build resolves through an unencrypted endpoint, so artifacts and checksums can be replaced in transit.
